name: @khorsheed/dsh-client-ui-reveal-kit
description: Shared client-side reveal kit for community sidebar panels: when the agent changes something or asks the user to look somewhere, take the panel there — without taking it from a user who is busy in it. A controller (busy rules, a per-viewer switch, notices, request de-duplication, console traces), a visible-page poll and a notice bar. Consumed at the SOURCE plane — each plugin's tsdown client bundle inlines it — never mounted as a plugin row.

compat.notes: A source-plane library, not a plugin: it registers no slot, service, locale or row, and owns no client bundle of its own. Consumers import `@khorsheed/dsh-client-ui-reveal-kit/src/client/*` directly, so tsdown inlines it into each plugin's own `lib/client.js`. It touches no host surface itself: the consumer passes the function that opens its tab (its own `sidebarRight.openTab`) and the words it shows. The host-side half — recording the agent's requests and returning them on the plugin's own poll — is a pattern each plugin implements on its own Remote (README), because a plugin's host build compiles only its own sources.
